description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for different consistency models. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 10.0, with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 25.0 to 33.0, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0. A purple line, representing “Consistency-CE”, is plotted with circular markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (2.0, 26.2) and ends at approximately (10.0, 31.6), showing a generally increasing trend with some fluctuations. A dark blue line, representing “Inconsistency-CE”, is plotted with square markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (2.0, 26.0) and ends at approximately (10.0, 31.4), also showing a generally increasing trend. A magenta line, representing “Inconsistency-CE-MP”, is plotted with square markers and a dashed line style; it begins at approximately (2.0, 26.0) and ends at approximately (10.0, 32.2), exhibiting a generally increasing trend. A red line, representing a model without a specified name, is plotted with star markers and a solid line style; it begins at approximately (2.0, 28.8) and ends at approximately (10.0, 32.4), also showing a generally increasing trend.
